description: Hand-seeded, source-cited supply-chain graph. available_at is when this project fetched and checked each source; the documents may have been public earlier. Filings are dated by their EDGAR filing date. Coordinates are approximate city or passage centroids from general geographic reference, not from the cited documents. TSMC nodes are the manufacturing fabs on its fab page; its Global R&D Center is not a fab and is omitted. Chokepoints have no ships_through edges yet.
